summary.headline: H1 FY27 revenue rose 71% to INR5,560 crores, but Q2 PAT grew only 6% to INR72 crores as net take rate fell about 4% QoQ to 5.06 bps.
summary.overview: AvenuesAI reported Q2 FY27 revenue from operations of INR2,879 crores, up 47% YoY, with operating EBITDA (excluding other income) of INR98.9 crores versus INR96.2 crores a year earlier. Q2 PAT was INR71.7 crores against INR67.6 crores, while H1 operating cash flow was negative INR192 crores, which management attributed mainly to faster merchant settlements. TPV rose 19% QoQ to INR1.77 lakh crores, but management deliberately prioritised scale over take rate. Management kept FY27 EPS guidance of INR8.75-9.5 with H1 EPS at about INR4.5, and said it had fallen short on net revenue growth, take rates and operating earnings momentum.

financial_highlights.change: driven by working capital, mainly faster merchant settlements

segments.name: Payments (CCAvenue)
segments.commentary: Q2 TPV rose 19% QoQ to INR1.77 lakh crores while net take rate fell about 4% QoQ to 5.06 bps, which management described as a deliberate pricing choice to win volume ahead of the festive season. Management says about 38-40% of UPI transactions are currently processed free, and that roughly 30% of these could become chargeable under MDR.

segments.name: Rediff
segments.commentary: Management put Rediff's annualised revenue run rate at upwards of INR200 crores and expected profit of about INR100 crores a year, with Rediff Fund as the largest profit driver. AvenuesAI owns about 82% and consolidates Rediff. A confidential DRHP has been filed and approved, but IPO timing is a Rediff board decision.

segments.name: International
segments.commentary: Management said UAE is performing well, Saudi Arabia is growing, and Oman's top four or five banks use its systems. The company is targeting the US next, and management said international margins are better than India's.

segments.name: ResAvenue (hospitality)
segments.commentary: Management said ResAvenue is live at more than 3,000 hotels and that its channel manager connects to about 150 OTA websites. It handled about 1.2 million room nights in the last 90 days, but no revenue figure was given.

guidance_outlook: FY27 guidance is EPS of INR8.75-9.5 (from slide 11); H1 EPS is about INR4.5 and management said it is not altering guidance.
FY27 consolidated revenue guidance of INR11,000-13,000 crores was reiterated; H1 revenue of INR5,560 crores is the base.
Management expects incremental TPV of INR50,000-1,00,000 crores over the next 24 months from partnerships (internal estimate).
Management expects to report the revenue effect of UPI MDR by next quarter; MDR implementation could be around January or earlier, pending NPCI.
Management expects margin compression near term from forward investment, with margin expansion dependent on take rates, UPI MDR and new services.
capex_capacity: About INR294 crores of the INR700 crore rights issue was earmarked for AI software and Quantum Edge sovereign data-centre investments; management said this capital is largely not yet deployed.
Management expects capital deployment into agent frameworks and TISco in the current quarter, and data-centre related spending in the current and next quarter.
RediffPay UPI onboarding: NPCI permission received and CUG phase completed; onboarding pending security and compliance as of mid-October 2026.
demand_pricing: Management said take rate was compressed by competitive pricing, and it prioritised scale to build data for AI and to capture festive volumes.
Management said payments is a competitive business and pricing varies by customer scale and vertical.

Management cited partnerships including Apple Pay (Oberoi Hotels), WhatsApp in-chat payments, WhatsApp Rocket checkout, CommerceAI 2.0 built on Google's A2A, and tap-to-pay on phone (after RBI permission).
Management said the MDR scope is undefined: management cited up to 40 bps as an earlier discussion, with no regulatory floor or ceiling and pricing subject to competition.

qa_highlights.question: Why did growth slow this quarter, and is it seasonal?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it prioritised scale over margin: net take rate fell about 4% QoQ to 5.06 bps, and it wanted volume for the festive season and data for AI.

qa_highlights.question: Is FY27 profit guidance intact?
qa_highlights.answer: Management reiterated EPS guidance of INR8.75-9.5 and said H1 EPS was about INR4.5, so it is not changing the guidance.

qa_highlights.question: What are Rediff Fund's revenue, EBITDA and cash contribution?
qa_highlights.answer: Rediff's run-rate revenue is upwards of INR200 crores and profit is about INR100 crores a year; Rediff Fund is the largest profit driver. Synergy timing was not quantified.

qa_highlights.question: How much have the OPL and Ratnaafin investments earned?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said these are long-term strategic investments held on the balance sheet, not in the P&L, and they generate no cash flow yet; no loan origination volumes were disclosed.

qa_highlights.question: How will AI-driven margin expansion be measured when TPV net revenue is falling?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said AI gives productivity gains, but much of the benefit is passed to merchants, and substantial backend cost is front-loaded; it framed TISco as a high-risk bet with a payoff of a few thousand times if successful.

qa_highlights.question: Is there any promoter selling and what about dividends?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said there is no promoter selling and that promoters invested in the rights issue. The board prefers retained earnings for growth, so there is no dividend for now.

risks_watch: Take rate compression (5.06 bps, down about 4% QoQ) against the PAT growth of only 6%. Watch whether scale translates into revenue and margin in Q3.
Negative H1 operating cash flow of INR192 crores from faster settlements. Watch working capital and cash balance (INR546.5 crores) against the INR5,145 crore equity base.
Uncertain timing and scope of UPI MDR, which could be implemented around January or earlier and whose revenue effect management will quantify next quarter.
About INR294 crores of rights-issue proceeds is largely undeployed; watch deployment into AI and TISco.
Rediff IPO timing and valuation are undetermined; watch for updates after the confidential DRHP approval.
Investments in OPL and Ratnaafin are held as strategic investments with no P&L or cash contribution disclosed.
summary.management_tone: Management was confident about scale, international growth and its AI strategy, but was cautious and often evasive on take rates, margins, TISco commercial timing, Rediff IPO timing and OPL/Ratnaafin economics. It openly conceded that take rate and operating earnings fell short of expectations.
key_quotes: Our net take rate during the quarter was 5.06 basis points, reflecting a competitive pricing strategy.
We fell a little short on the net revenue growth, take rates, the operating earnings momentum.
OPL and Ratnaafin are investments. We don't record any of those transactions and values as part of our P&L and balance sheet.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Net take rate fell about 4% QoQ to 5.06 bps and management expects margin compression near term from forward investment; Q2 operating EBITDA was INR98.9 crores, only about +3% YoY on revenue up 47%.

rows.why: Data-centre spend under Quantum Edge (part of INR294 crores earmarked from rights issue, largely undeployed) is expected in the current and next quarter, but no capacity figures were given and capex is not a physical plant build.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: TPV rose 19% QoQ to INR1.77 lakh crores in Q2 and management targets INR50,000-1,00,000 crores of incremental TPV over 24 months from partnerships, though that is an internal estimate.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: No utilisation metric applies to this payments and software business; INR294 crores of rights-issue money is largely undeployed and earmarked for AI and Quantum Edge, so further capital deployment is likely to be disclosed rather than a new plant.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management held FY27 EPS guidance of INR8.75-9.5 with H1 EPS at about INR4.5 and conceded it fell short on net revenue growth, take rates and operating earnings momentum.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: H1 EPS of about INR4.5 needs H2 EPS of about INR4.25-5.0 to reach the INR8.75-9.5 range, while take rate fell 4% QoQ and management expects near-term margin compression.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Partnerships already named include Apple Pay (Oberoi Hotels), WhatsApp in-chat payments, WhatsApp Rocket checkout, CommerceAI 2.0 on Google A2A and tap-to-pay on phone, and RediffPay UPI onboarding is pending security and compliance.

rows.label: UPI MDR implementation and revenue effect
rows.why: Management expects the MDR revenue effect to be reported next quarter and implementation around January or earlier, but scope is undefined (up to 40 bps discussed) and about 30% of the 38-40% free UPI transactions could become chargeable.

rows.label: Take rate recovery after festive-season volume push
rows.why: Net take rate fell about 4% QoQ to 5.06 bps as a deliberate choice to win volume, and management said pricing is competitive, so a near-term rebound is not signalled.

rows.label: Negative H1 operating cash flow reversal
rows.why: H1 operating cash flow was negative INR192 crores from faster merchant settlements against cash of INR546.5 crores, and no reversal timing was given.
